segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ חוּטִין הַחִיצוֹנוֹת שֶׁנִּפְגְּמוּ, וְשֶׁנִּגְמְמוּ, הַפְּנִימִיִּם שֶׁנֶּעֶקְרוּ. רַבִּי חֲנִינָא בֶּן אַנְטִיגְנוֹס אוֹמֵר: אֵין בּוֹדְקִין מִן הַתְּיוֹמֶת וְלִפְנִים, וְאַף לֹא אֶת הַתְּיוֹמֶת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» The mishna lists additional blemishes that permit the slaughter of the firstborn: «The external gums that were damaged» and lacking «or that were scratched,» and likewise, «the internal» gums «that were extracted. Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus says: One does not examine from the double teeth,» i.e., the large molars that appear like two teeth, «and inward, and» one does «not» examine «even the» place of the «double teeth» themselves. This is because even if they were extracted, it is a concealed blemish, and it does not permit the slaughter of the firstborn.
